# Histology, Periodontium

**Authors:** Shahrzad Torabi, Abhinandan Soni

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The periodontium is a connective tissue consisting of four components: cementum, the periodontal ligament (PDL), alveolar bone, and gingival tissue (see Image. Periodontium Anatomy). This topic details the histological and embryological structure and origin of this tissue, as well as the function, clinical significance, and pathophysiology of some of the periodontal diseases.
